import json, os, torch
result=dict(CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=os.environ.get("CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG"), CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=os.environ.get("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"), model_calls=0, feedback_samples=0, optimizer_updates=0)
torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
torch.cuda.set_device(0)
result["free_before_bytes"]=torch.cuda.mem_get_info()[0]
try:
    x=torch.ones((16,16),device="cuda",dtype=torch.float32)
    y=x@x
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    result.update(status="PASS", exact_all_elements_16=bool(torch.all(y==16).item()))
except Exception as error:
    result.update(status="ERROR", error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error))
result["peak_allocated_bytes"]=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()
result["free_after_bytes"]=torch.cuda.mem_get_info()[0]
print(json.dumps(result))
